content:
The business model you have proposed is definitely unique and has the potential to be successful. Many consumers would likely be interested in using a virtual credit card to sign up for trials without the risk of being charged for unwanted subscriptions.

In terms of pricing, it would depend on the level of convenience and security your service provides. The average monthly fee could range from $5 to $20 per month. 

Reaching 500 customers could take anywhere from 6 months to a year, depending on your marketing efforts and the demand for your service. 

Alternate ways to make money through this business could include offering premium features or additional services for a higher fee, partnering with businesses to offer special discounts to your users, or selling anonymized data to companies for market research purposes.

If the business had only 10 users, it would likely not be worth much in terms of selling to another entrepreneur or technology asset firm. A rough figure could be in the range of $1,000 to $5,000.
